title: Testing Your Twist
use_cases: Use when evaluating if a narrative revelation is logically sound and foreshadowed
Configure when performing an audit of clues to ensure fair play for readers
Implement when checking if character motivations remain consistent post-revelation
Use when validating if a plot twist improves the overall satisfaction of the story retrospectively
content:
Before finalizing your plot twist, subject it to rigorous testing:

The Hindsight Test: Does the twist make the entire story more satisfying when viewed in retrospect? Do previously confusing elements now make sense?

The Clue Audit: Can readers find all necessary information in the text before the revelation? Mark every clue that supports your twist and ensure they're all present and accessible.

The Motivation Check: Does the twist provide adequate motivation for all character actions? Can you trace each character's behavior back to logical psychological foundations?

The Fair Play Review: Could a careful, intelligent reader solve the mystery based on the information provided? The answer should be "yes, but it would be difficult."
